title.zh: 设立Cavite Be Known Julian Felipe Day市
title.en: An Act Declaring January 28 of Every Year as a Nonworking Special Public Holiday in the City of Cavite to Be Known as Julian Felipe Day
title.orig: An Act Declaring January 28 of Every Year as a Nonworking Special Public Holiday in the City of Cavite to Be Known as Julian Felipe Day

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7805_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In celebration of the birth anniversary of Professor Julian R. Felipe and in recognition of his talent and ingenuity in the masterful constitution of the national anthem, the 28th of January of every year is hereby declared as a nonworking special public holiday in the City of Cavite to be known as Julian Felipe Day.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
